# My Business Care Team (MyBCAT)

> My Business Care Team (MyBCAT) provides centralized patient access operations for healthcare practices and multi-location groups. We handle inbound calls, scheduling, intake, recalls, and front-desk workflows with direct EHR/PMS scheduling and HIPAA-aligned processes. Founded 2018, headquartered in Marietta, GA. Serving 70+ practices nationwide.

## Canonical URL rules
- Primary domain: https://mybcat.com
- Trailing slashes are canonical (e.g., /solutions/ not /solutions)
